description: Terrain elevation from the Copernicus Digital Elevation Model (~90m resolution) for one or more coordinate pairs. Accepts up to 100 pairs per call. Useful for geographic context, elevation-adjusted weather interpretation, or route planning.

latitudes.description: Array of latitudes in decimal degrees (up to 100). Must be same length as longitudes.

longitudes.description: Array of longitudes in decimal degrees (up to 100). Must be same length as latitudes.

name: openmeteo_get_elevation

items.description: Elevation for a single coordinate pair

elevation_m.description: Terrain elevation in meters above sea level

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `coordinate_count_mismatch`: The latitudes and longitudes arrays have different lengths. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

title: Openmeteo Get Elevation
